content_sections.text: Advt No. C-89/2026-IIMK.HR gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IIMK notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Masters'/ Bachelors' degree in any subject. Administrative Experience of one year in respect of Post-Graduates, and two years in respect of Graduates. Experience: Administrative Experience of one year in respect of Post-Graduates, and two years in respect of Graduates Age limit: Maximum 35 years Other conditions: Ability to communicate in English, oral and written Ability of noting and drafting independently Exposure to work in computerized environment, especially Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Power point etc.) Result-orientated and able to work under pressure to achieve targets Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, students and members of the public of all age groups and social backgrounds Ability to undertake clerical work on academic administration

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for IIMK Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates found ineligible at any stage will be disqualified and their candidature cancelled Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely on contract basis initially for a period of 6 months Extension, if any, subject to job requirements and performance

content_sections.text: Screening of applications Interview of shortlisted candidates Applications will be screened and shortlisted candidates alone will be interviewed Interview time slots will be communicated by e-mail Date and time of interview to be decided later Decision of the Director, IIMK regarding the selection will be final

content_sections.text: Certificates (SSLC onwards) CV Photograph Final mark lists Experience certificates Signature

content_sections.text: Applications without necessary documents or incomplete in any other aspect will be summarily rejected Applicants should visit the website or check emails regularly for any change of interview schedule Engagement subject to verification of all certificates and experience at the time of joining Institute reserves the right to revise/reschedule/cancel/suspend the recruitment process without assigning any reason For technical difficulty contact [email protected] or [email protected]

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIMK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIMK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Admin. Associate.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIMK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.27,800 consolidated per month (including accommodation allowance of Rs.3,500 and telephone allowance of Rs.300 ) = Rs. 31,600 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Masters'/ Bachelors' degree in any subject, with administrative experience of one year for Post-Graduates and two years for Graduates.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Ability to communicate in English, oral and written. Ability of noting and drafting independently. Exposure to work in computerized environment, especially Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Power point etc.). Result-orientated and able to work under pressure to achieve targets.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates found ineligible at any stage will be disqualified and their candidature cancelled. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening of applications. Interview of shortlisted candidates. Applications will be screened and shortlisted candidates alone will be interviewed. Interview time slots will be communicated by e-mail.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on contract basis initially for a period of 6 months. Extension, if any, subject to job requirements and performance.
